resources.string: Enter the address of your Melyxar server, for example 192.168.1.20:2100.
This is not a server address.
Outside your home network, the address must start with https:// so your password is never sent in the clear.
No Melyxar server answers at this address.
%1$s does not answer. Check that it is running and that this device is on the right network.
